purpose: Fit one regularized monotone logistic/temperature calibration from the v03 raw semantic log-product score using Q-v02 train rows only; compare with raw and isotonic outputs on validation/test and sensor-overlap strata.

training_contract.input: v03 semantic_log_score; null maps to a train-derived finite lower floor
training_contract.target: independent typed-validator labels from Q-v02 selected candidate rows
training_contract.score_floor: min finite training score minus max(1, finite training-score standard deviation)
training_contract.standardization: mean and population standard deviation over all train scores after null-floor substitution
training_contract.objective: mean binary cross-entropy plus 0.5 * 1.0 * slope^2; intercept unpenalized
training_contract.temperature: standardization_scale / fitted_slope; positive slope preserves raw score order

evaluation.selection_score: raw semantic log score; calibrated probability is a confidence output, with calibrated-logit top-1 also reported

runtime_export.format: five little-endian float64 coefficients: floor, center, scale, nonnegative slope, intercept
runtime_export.input: raw semantic log score; replace negative infinity with floor, standardize, apply logistic
